title: Rain-sensing wipers, roof rain noise, and battery charging concern
summary: This topic combines unrelated comments about rain-sensing wiper behavior, rain noise on the roof, and a battery chemistry charging concern.

positive.summary: One positive review says the roof’s sound in rain is like rain on an iron plate, suggesting the noise was notable without being framed as a complaint.

negative.summary: One negative review dislikes the steps needed to adjust wiper speed while using rain sensor mode.

undetermined.summary: Two undetermined reviews mention nonfunctioning rain-sensing wipers and a preference for lithium iron phosphate batteries to reduce concern about charging to full, but the sentiment direction is not explicit in the supplied examples.

limitations: The sampled fragments mix unrelated subjects rather than one coherent issue.
There are only a few examples, so the available evidence is limited.
Two of the four examples are undetermined, which restricts clear interpretation of overall sentiment.
